name: How do you dispose of a removed bathtub?

mainEntity.name: How do you dispose of a removed bathtub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Disposal methods for removed bathtubs depend on their material. Fiberglass and acrylic tubs are often taken to local landfills or recycling centers that accept plastics. Cast iron tubs are very heavy and can often be recycled as scrap metal, which may even offer a small monetary return. Contractors typically handle the hauling and proper disposal, ensuring compliance with local waste management regulations and often factoring disposal fees into the overall project cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fiberglass/acrylic tubs go to landfills or recycling centers. Cast iron tubs are often recycled as scrap metal. Contractors manage hauling and disposal according to local regulations.
